name: board_hulk
_comment: U9 wave 6: boarding a NON-mission disabled ship. Pilot w6_board (Kit Crawler 100, inertialess, 44 px/s) at Kit Board Port (sÿst 2020), whose only traffic is one Kit Hulk (immobile magenta disc of the derelict gövt 378: starts disabled). Tab targets it; loops/board.mjs steers to it by measurement (colour on screen, radar off screen), then steps in 0.25 s at a time pressing b at every stop, and shoots the boarding dialog if one opens. Read each stop's status-line answer from the b-* shots; the distances are in log.jsonl (phase script) and result.
